title: wlan_statistics_dialog.cpp: Refactor common elements
description:
Create a base class to handle common functionality.
Move is_broadcast_bssid() within the UI as that's the only place it's called.

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 6d156139 - wlan_statistics_dialog.cpp: Refactor common elements
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/21487/diffs?diff_id=1506399148&start_sha=92a1716db18b98bdaf5914c468f223323609651f)

Can you change the names of the getters to omit the "get_" and use camelCase, e.g. `packets`, `dataPackets`, `sentPackets`, etc? This would match [our convention for method names](https://www.wireshark.org/docs/wsdg_html_chunked/ChUIQt.html#_coding_practices_and_naming_conventions) and [Qt's convention for getter names](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/properties.html). When reading the UI code, it makes it more obvious whether or not a particular function is calling a UI method vs a part of epan, wsutil, or wiretap.

LGTM otherwise.
